summary: The models learned only from Khan Younis. Without any change, they were scored once on all 2,592 hectares of farmland in Deir Al-Balah, the governorate to the north. The main model scored 0.85 (Dec 2024) and 0.87 (Jul 2025) there, against 0.86 and 0.84 on Khan Younis test land.
columns: Main model in Deir Al-Balah (95% range)
note: Scores are macro F1, from 0 to 1. The rules of this test were published before it was scored (docs/test_plan_region.md); it was run once, at 2026-11-15 01:47, code version 1128679. A lead over the rule counts only if its whole range is above zero.
